ayahs.2: Aur jab sitaare be-noor ho jaaenge.
ayahs.4: Aur jab das maah ki haamila ontniyan chhod di jaaen.
ayahs.5: Aur jab wahshi jaanwar ikatthe kiye jaaenge.
ayahs.7: Aur jab jaanen (jismon se) mila di jaaengi.
ayahs.8: Aur jab zinda gaadi hui ladki se sawaal kiya jaayega.
ayahs.9: Ke kis gunah ki wajah se woh qatl ki gayi?
ayahs.10: Aur jab naama-e-aamaal khol diye jaaenge.
ayahs.11: Aur jab aasman ki khaal utaar li jaayegi.
ayahs.13: Aur jab jannat nazdeek kar di jaayegi.
ayahs.14: To us din har shakhs jaan lega jo kuchh le kar aaya hoga.
ayahs.15: Main qasam khaata hoon peechhe hatne wale.
ayahs.16: Chalne phirne wale, chhupne wale sitaaron ki.
ayahs.17: Aur raat ki jab jaane lage.
ayahs.18: Aur subah ki jab chamakne lage.
ayahs.19: Yaqeenan yeh ek buzurg Rasool ka kaha hua hai.
ayahs.20: Jo quwwat wala hai, Arsh wale (Allah) ke nazdeek buland martaba hai.
ayahs.21: Jis ki (aasmanon mein) itaat ki jaati hai aur ameen hai.
ayahs.22: Aur tumhara saathi deewana nahin hai.
ayahs.23: Us ne is (farishte) ko aasman ke khule kinaare par dekha bhi hai.
ayahs.24: Aur yeh ghaib ki baaton ko batlaane mein bakheel bhi nahin.
ayahs.25: Aur yeh Quran shaitaan mardood ka kalaam nahin.
ayahs.26: Phir tum kahan ja rahe ho.
ayahs.27: Yeh to tamaam jahaan walon ke liye naseehat-naama hai.
ayahs.28: (Bil-khusoos) us ke liye jo tum mein se seedhi raah par chalna chaahe.
ayahs.29: Aur tum baghair Parwardigaar-e-aalam ke chaahe kuchh nahin chaah sakte.
